cases.title: Selects and holds everything: names where the should-fade layer now waits and jumps; asks about the extra holds; no fix

rubric.reason: Turn 3 says Cut "doesn't fade between 3 s and 3.1 s anymore. It waits, then jumps," and asks "Did you mean for Card and Pause to change?" about the extra holds. It gives no fix and doesn't offer one, only "check the keys at those times."

Turn 3 points at what is off and where with real names and times (Cut at 3 s, Card Position and Scale at 1.2 s, Pause Position at 5 s and 6 s), hands it back with "Say 'done' when you've had a look," and never offers to fix it or spells out fix steps.

Every name and time matches the tool results: Blink Opacity at 1, 1.4, 1.8 and 2.2 s; Cut at 3 s to 3.1 s; Dot 1's jump at 0.5 s; Card Position and Scale at 1.2 s; Pause Position at 5 s and 6 s. "Two weeks ago you eased Title's moves in Mentor Practice" matches the record dated 2026-10-12.
